intent: Fix the rough token-count fallback in local_executor.py so it never returns 0 for non-empty text when tiktoken is unavailable. Done when the fallback returns at least 1 for any non-empty string and the new behaviour is covered by a test.

acceptance_criteria.statement: count_tokens returns >=1 for any non-empty input even with tiktoken disabled.
A regression test for the non-empty fallback is added.

executor.prompt: Implement the fix described in the intent. Return a unified diff limited to allowed_paths plus the new test.
